```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: iris-scatterplot
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = seq(0, 8, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.5), breaks = seq(0, 4.5, by = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sepal Measurements by Iris Species",
    x = "Sepal length (cm)",
    y = "Sepal width (cm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
